title: Chapter 263: Human-Controlled Battle Situation
content:
Chapter 263: Human-Controlled Battle Situation

On the battlefield, almost all the follow-up attacking forces of the alien army were pulled into the melee by the Zerg puppies and pinned down.

The Zerg puppies had some difficulty in besieging the alien army, but they were no problem against other armies.

Every time the Zerg puppies came on the field, it was a real war of attrition. A large number of Zerg puppies died, which resulted in an explosive reduction in the number of the alien army.

Especially those goblins who made up the numbers, basically they couldn't even take a move from the Zerg puppies, and all of them were targets for slaughter.

What's more terrifying is that the tens of millions of Zerg puppies that drilled out of the ground to participate in the war were not all the Zerg puppies in Wu Qing's hands.

In the Zerg base under the battlefield, there were still a large number of Zerg puppies who made way for other arms and did not come out.

The thousands of Zerg mother nests of various star levels in the Zerg base were still hatching Zerg puppies with all their strength.

With every passing second, tens of thousands of Zerg puppies would hatch.

The Zerg dog sea that Wu Qing had always wanted was truly formed this time!

When all the main Zerg troops that reinforced the Zerg army's defensive positions went out, a large number of Zerg puppies emerged from the ground through the underground passages distributed everywhere.

The exits of those underground passages were like giant springs spraying water outward, spraying countless Zerg puppies.

When the Zerg puppies entered the battlefield, they rushed towards the nearby alien army. No matter what kind of enemy they faced, they would attack desperately.

Those who could be defeated would be killed efficiently, and those who could not be defeated would be injured in exchange for their lives. There would be other Zerg puppies standing on their achievements and finally killing the enemy!

The Zerg puppies' fighting style could not be resisted by the armies of the various affiliated races of the alien race. Even if some of their troops were very powerful, they could not withstand the continuous siege of the Zerg puppies.

The current situation was reversed all of a sudden, and the Zerg army's strength was gradually gaining an advantage.

The Zerg base was underground, and the Zerg puppies' strength increased very quickly. Every second, a large number of Zerg puppies joined the battlefield and launched an attack on the alien army.

The reinforcements of the alien army can no longer keep up with their loss rate.

Moreover, at this point in the battle, in addition to the continuous flow of troops sent by the alien army through the space transmission channel, there are not many troops coming directly from the surrounding areas of the 66th City.

"The reinforcement speed of the Zerg is too fast! It seems that the entire underground has become the Zerg's nest!"

"The strength of the Zerg's melee troops will soon exceed 20 million if it continues to grow at this rate!"

"With this scale of troops, even if the aliens come with a few complete versions of large-scale battlefield magic, it will be useless, let alone using a small number of high-star troops to turn the tide of the battle!"

"I don't know which troop in the Zerg army has a sure-kill ability. This sure-kill ability seems to be recoverable. Over time, all the five-star troops in the alien army will be killed!"

"The number of troops in the Zerg army that can spray sticky nets is as large as the number of troops in each Zerg army. The ultimate killing ability seems to be somewhat related, but it is unlikely! "

"Yes, for a race like the Zerg that uses its body as a weapon, they generally have only one powerful ability, or several similar abilities of the same type. All the arms of the Zerg are in line with this feature!"

"One-hit kill and spraying sticky nets to restrict and bind are two completely different types of abilities, and it is unlikely that they will appear in one arm!"

"Perhaps this ability is not an ability of an arm, but may be an item!"

"..."

There is no shortage of smart people in the world. Observers from various forces in the local camp almost discovered the ability of the Zerg Queen while chatting.

Wu Qing also knew that the number of Zerg Queens was a loophole, so the Zerg Queens were hidden in the Zerg Dragon Group.

This was still discovered by careful observers, who linked their number with the one-hit kill ability of the Zerg army every time.

Now even if the ability of the Zerg Queen is exposed, the impact is not great. On the battlefield, it is very difficult to avoid the attack of the Zerg Queen.

Wu Qing's idea is to hide if you can. Mystery is sometimes important. If you can't hide, it doesn't matter.

"Boom boom boom...!"

The Zerg Destroyers' cannons continued to roar. They were attacking the alien army outside the 66th city. The Zerg Puppies had not yet reached these positions.

The Zerg army's defensive positions and the alien army around the defense line were all cleared out. Only some alien air forces led by the Light Griffin Knights were left in the sky, still struggling with the Zerg Mutalisks and Zerg Hydralisks on the ground.

Because of the participation of the five-star flying arms of the aliens, the Zerg Mutalisks and the Zerg Hydralisks on the ground suffered certain losses.

The five-star Zerg Mutalisks and Zerg Hydralisks confronted the five-star arms of the alien army led by the Light Griffin Knights.

The Zerg Queen, who was waiting for the recovery of her spawning ability, looked for opportunities from time to time to spray traps to interfere with the actions of the alien flying arms.

A large number of Zerg Hydralisks joined the battle, and the quantitative change led to the qualitative change. The five-star flying arms of the aliens could not resist and could only retreat continuously.

The Zerg Dragon followed closely with the Zerg Queen and Zerg Exploding Swarm to attack and control.

On the ground battlefield, among the main Zerg combat units on the Zerg army's defensive positions, only the Zerg Destroyer was still attacking, and the other units had lost their targets.

At Wu Qing's command, the Zerg Hydralisks, Zerg Cockroaches and Zerg Stealth Spiders in the Zerg army began to advance in formation in the direction of the space transmission channel built by the alien race!

The main combat units of the Zerg army took the initiative to launch a counterattack against the alien army. Their attack direction was the direction of the alien army, which the Zerg dogs had a very hard time fighting.

The alien army in this direction is the strongest, and has a particularly powerful light magic blessing. The actual combat power of each soldier is enough to fight across star levels, and the one-star strength can fight against the two-star units.

The individual combat power of the alien army is almost equivalent to that of the Zerg individual soldiers of the same strength. They are well-equipped, well-trained, determined, and experienced in combat. Ordinary Zerg dogs have no advantage in fighting against them.

The Zerg puppies in the melee with the alien army quickly fell into a disadvantage.

The Zerg puppies fought to the death, and the alien army paid a certain price in casualties to clear out all the Zerg puppies that mixed into their formation and reorganized a defensive formation.

In this way, their crossbowmen can effectively play the advantages of long-range attack troops under the protection of melee troops.

The surrounding Zerg puppies attacked the various defensive formations of the alien army, and suffered heavy casualties.

The alien army quickly eliminated the threat of Zerg puppies and regrouped to form a formation. This has both advantages and disadvantages.

This formation is beneficial for them to defend against the impact of Zerg puppies, but it also gives the super-long-range attack troops in the Zerg army an opportunity.

The Zerg destroyer has the real-time battlefield intelligence support of the Zerg host and can accurately attack the various squares of the alien army.

The alien army in other directions has an average combat power comparable to that of the Zerg puppies, or even inferior to it, and no longer needs the firepower support of the Zerg destroyer.

Just then, the alien army gave the Zerg destroyers an opportunity to attack. Fifty thousand Zerg destroyers began to launch fierce fire coverage on the various squares of the alien army.

"Boom boom boom...!"

The surrounding Zerg puppies were not idle either. They ignored the indiscriminate attacks of the Zerg destroyers and continued to attack the squares of the alien army.

When the main combat arms of the Zerg army advanced to the front of the alien army, the Zerg puppies gave up the attack position, and the Zerg Hydralisks, Zerg Stealth Spiders and Zerg Cockroaches took over the Zerg puppies and launched a more fierce long-range attack.

The alien army, whose long-range arms were suppressed by the Zerg destroyers, could only passively take the beating in the face of the Zerg main combat arms that were all long-range attacks.

Faced with this situation, the melee arms of the alien army had no choice but to rush to the surrounding Zerg puppies.

It is difficult for them to succeed in attacking the firepower network of the main combat arms of the Zerg army. If they rush into the Zerg Zerg group and fight in a melee, there is still a glimmer of hope. At worst, they can destroy some Zerg Zerg Zerg.

Except for the Zerg biodegradation fluid sprayed by the Zerg Hydralisk, the attacks of other arms cannot avoid their own people.

For those alien human troops who rushed into the Zerg Zerg group, only the Zerg Hydralisk sprayed biodegradation fluid to help, and the rest depended on the combat power of the Zerg Zerg Zerg itself.

With the continuous replenishment of the Zerg base, the number of Zerg Zerg Zerglings is increasing. Some losses are not important at all. As long as the alien human army can be destroyed, it is a profit.

When the number of Zerg Zerg Zerglings is so large that they can completely suppress the alien human army, a large number of Zerg Zerg Zerglings hatched in the Zerg base under the battlefield went underground to wait and no longer entered the battlefield to participate in the battle.

Wu Qing's operation made people mistakenly think that the Zerg reinforcements had finally arrived.

At this time, the Zerg army did not have an absolute advantage on the battlefield. A large number of Zerg dogs were consuming each other with the alien army. Every moment, countless soldiers from both sides fell on the battlefield and disappeared.

The space transmission channel built by the aliens was constantly transmitting troops. This was a large space transmission channel, and each transmission could transmit about 100,000 troops.

The Zerg army was cut off from reinforcements by Wu Qing, and the reinforcements of the aliens continued, which made the battle situation in the direction of the alien space transmission channel stalemate again.

The main combat force of the Zerg army, which had been advancing forward, was advancing more and more slowly even with the full support of the Zerg destroyers.

The Zerg dogs deployed by the Zerg in this direction were replaced in batches, and countless were killed.

With the continuous reinforcement of the aliens, the situation seemed to be changing again.
